content.title: Permit Payments
content.summary: Payments for approved permits can be made online through the Permit Portal using a Visa or Mastercard. After logging in, users can select the fees to pay, add them to a shopping cart, and proceed to a secure payment screen to complete the transaction, with confirmation sent via email once the payment is processed.
content.body:
Once a permit / project has been approved, payments can be made online through the [Permit Portal]([NEW PORTAL URL]) using a Visa or Mastercard. An email notification to the applicant will be sent when the permit is ready for payment.

1. **Login at the Permit Portal:**  
	Once logged in, you will select the fee that you want to pay. Permits that are available to be paid, will display the fee due in blue. Select the fee in blue to add it to the shopping cart.
2. **Load items to shopping cart:**  
	Review the total amount that you are paying. To add more permits, select "Back to Dashboard" and repeat step one in this process. Once you are satisfied with the contents of your shopping cart, select "Proceed to Checkout".  
	**Note:** Unpaid items will remain in the shopping cart until they are removed or paid.
3. **Review payments:  
	**Once you have added all of the payments to your shopping cart, select "Proceed to Payment."
4. **Complete payment:  
	**You will be redirected to a secure payment screen to complete your credit card payment using a Visa or Mastercard. Once the payment has processed, you will be redirected back to the Permit Portal to review your permits. A copy of the payments will be sent via email.
